title: Settings

account.title: Account
account.unavailable: No account needed. Your checks stay on this phone.
account.noneBody: Everything works without one. Create an account to keep your checks and contacts if you change phone, and to get a higher hourly check limit.

sync.done: Your checks and contacts are synced.
sync.error: Sync is paused. We will try again next time you open the app.

language.title: Language
language.body: The app, your reports, spoken warnings and Talk to $t(common:appName) all use this language.

destination: Where I will work or travel

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics log
diagnostics.privacy: This log stays on your phone. It contains no messages or personal details. Share it only if the $t(common:appName) team asks.
diagnostics.copied: Report copied. Paste it in a message to the $t(common:appName) team.
diagnostics.clearMessage: This deletes all log entries on this phone.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.share: Help others: share anonymous scam patterns
privacy.shareBody: Off unless you turn it on. No screenshots and no message text are shared. Names and personal details are removed first, phone numbers and accounts are kept only as one-way codes, and website names may be kept. Shared patterns are deleted after 90 days. Report a scam always shares, because you choose to send it.
privacy.history: Keep check history on this phone
privacy.historyBody: When this is off, $t(common:appName) keeps only the check you are looking at and deletes saved checks. Signed-in accounts also stop syncing checks.
privacy.p1: Your checks are saved on this phone while history is on. Signed-in accounts also sync a short record of each check (verdict, scam type and $t(common:appName)'s summary), trusted contacts and settings. Your messages, screenshots and links are never synced. Without an account, contacts saved earlier stay on this phone and new ones cannot be saved.
privacy.p2: To check something, $t(common:appName) sends the text, link or screenshot to our check service, which uses Google AI models and Google Safe Browsing to assess it. We do not log the content.
privacy.p3: Each install gets an anonymous ID. We use it only to limit how many checks one person can run per hour.
privacy.p4: You can delete the data on this device at any time. Account holders can also delete their account and everything synced.
privacy.p5: A diagnostics log on this phone records error codes and timings. It holds no messages or personal details. It is shared only if you choose to send it.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.message: Your checks and contacts stay in your account. This device will be cleared.

deleteLocal.title: Delete data on this device?
deleteLocal.messageSynced: This clears checks, contacts and settings on this device and signs you out. Your account and its synced copies stay until you delete the account.
deleteLocal.messageLocal: This clears your checks, trusted contacts and settings on this device.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.message: This permanently deletes your account and everything synced to it. Data on this device is cleared too.

historyOff.title: Delete saved checks?
historyOff.message: Turning this off deletes the checks saved on this phone.
historyOff.messageSynced: Turning this off deletes the checks saved on this phone and in your account.

deleted.title: Account deleted
deleted.message: Your account and synced data are gone.
